keyFindings.claim: Network access depends on the environment allowlist: initially every asset site was blocked; after a same-day allowlist update Poly Haven, ambientCG, kenney.nl, blender.org/docs/download and threejs.org became reachable. git clone, raw.githubusercontent.com, npm and PyPI always work.
keyFindings.detail: Re-tested 2026-10-14: Poly Haven API + dl.polyhaven.org file URLs 200 (md5 matched), ambientCG API + zip via acg-download.struffelproductions.com 200, kenney.nl pack zip 200. Still blocked: quaternius.com, opengameart.org, itch.io, sketchfab.com, mixamo.com, fonts.google.com, lospec.com, jsdelivr/unpkg; poly.pizza 403 (Cloudflare); GitHub release downloads 403.
sources: local test: curl/git from this container 2026-10-14
keyFindings.implicationForOrbkin: Probe reachability at session start; use official CC0 APIs when allowed, git/npm mirrors otherwise, owner downloads for the rest; never download executables.

keyFindings.claim: Official CC0 downloads verified from Poly Haven, ambientCG and Kenney after the allowlist update.
keyFindings.detail: Poly Haven: api.polyhaven.com/files/<id> lists map types and URLs with md5 (rock_wall_08 diffuse 1k matched); HDRI and 110 nature models listed. ambientCG: /api/v2/full_json?id=Rock030&include=downloadData -> 1K-8K zips; 1K-JPG zip holds AO/Color/Displacement/NormalDX/NormalGL/Roughness JPGs plus .blend/.usdc/.mtlx/.tres (extract images only). Kenney Nature Kit 2.1 zip: 329 GLB (+FBX/OBJ/DAE/STL) and License.txt stating CC0. Licence pages: Poly Haven 'CC0 means absolute freedom', ambientCG 'Creative Commons CC0'.
keyFindings.implicationForOrbkin: A fetch script can pull exact CC0 assets with checksums and licence evidence into the repo, recorded in ASSETS.md.

keyFindings.claim: KayKit's official GitHub org hosts 10 CC0 packs with GLB/glTF files (no LFS) that clone fine here.
keyFindings.detail: KayKit-Game-Assets: Dungeon Remastered (203 GLB + FBX/OBJ), Adventurers (4 rigged characters, 75 animations, 25+ accessories), Skeletons, Prototype Bits, City Builder, Medieval Hexagon (200+), Furniture, Restaurant, Halloween, Space Base. README: CC0, no attribution; single 1024x1024 gradient atlas texture per pack.
keyFindings.implicationForOrbkin: Ready-made shelves, barrels, chests, stairs, tables, banners and rigged humanoids for the lodge/quarry dioramas and trainers; re-texture with our pixel palette.

keyFindings.claim: 1,545 Quaternius models (32 packs, all CC0 upstream) are reachable as GLB via the trebeljahr/quaternius-showcase repo.
keyFindings.detail: public/glb/<pack>/ includes nature_pack (150), house_interior_pack (123), rpg_items, crops, animals (with 13 animation actions on Deer), dinosaurs, fish, modular men/women. LICENSES.md lists CC0-1.0 per pack, checked 2026-10-10. Quaternius' Animated Monsters/Ultimate Monsters packs are not mirrored.
keyFindings.implicationForOrbkin: Trees, bushes, rocks, interior props and animal animation references for outdoor arenas and creature motion studies.

keyFindings.claim: Kenney's CC0 content is reachable through official Starter Kits and an unofficial 2020 mirror of 128 packs.
keyFindings.detail: KenneyNL/Starter-Kit-* contain GLB models; ETdoFresh/kenney.nl has 1,425 GLB, 33,866 PNG and 10 Kenney fonts (snapshot July 2020). Kenney terms: CC0, attribution optional.
keyFindings.implicationForOrbkin: Particle/smoke sprites for move FX, prototype textures, nature/castle/graveyard kits as greybox geometry.

keyFindings.claim: npm packages carry real CC0/OFL assets: @pmndrs/assets and @fontsource/*.
keyFindings.detail: @pmndrs/assets 1.7.0 (CC0, 19 MB): 18 HDRIs (EXR as base64 modules), 284 matcaps, 29 normal maps, Inter. @fontsource/* exposes every Google Font under OFL-1.1, incl. pixel faces Press Start 2P, Pixelify Sans, Silkscreen, Tiny5, Micro 5, Jersey 10, VT323, DotGothic16.
keyFindings.implicationForOrbkin: Matcaps and HDRIs for stylised bakes and IBL; font fallbacks without leaving the npm toolchain.

keyFindings.claim: Poly Haven HDRIs are available here via pmndrs/drei-assets (12 at 1k) even though polyhaven.com is blocked.
keyFindings.detail: drei-assets/hdri/*.hdr (venice_sunset, kiara_1_dawn, forest_slope, st_fagans_interior, etc.), CC0 from Poly Haven; also matcaps, normal maps and LUT PNGs (LUT provenance unclear). Poly Haven assets are CC0; its live API needs a custom licence for commercial apps.
keyFindings.implicationForOrbkin: Use as Cycles world lighting when baking AO/irradiance into props and sprites.

keyFindings.claim: pip bpy 5.2.2 (headless Blender) includes Rigify, Node Wrangler and glTF/FBX import-export; Cycles CPU renders work.
keyFindings.detail: addon_utils lists cycles, io_scene_gltf2, io_scene_fbx, io_anim_bvh, io_curve_svg, io_mesh_uv_layout, node_wrangler, pose_library, rigify. Imported KayKit chest/barrel and Quaternius tree/deer GLBs and rendered 480x160 @16spp in about 1 s. EEVEE unavailable (no libEGL); extensions.blender.org blocked.
keyFindings.implicationForOrbkin: Blender-by-script is the in-container art tool: import, retexture, bake, rig (Rigify), render sprites, export GLB.

keyFindings.claim: Most GUI art tools are free but owner-machine only; several have scriptable formats or CLIs.
keyFindings.detail: Blockbench (GPL-3, .bbmodel JSON), Krita/GIMP (GPL), Pixelorama (MIT), LibreSprite (GPL-2, -b CLI), Aseprite (source-available EULA: compile for personal use, output commercial OK, no redistribution of binaries), Material Maker (MIT, --export CLI in parse_args.gd but needs Godot+GPU), ArmorPaint 1.0 (zlib source, binaries paid), MagicaVoxel (free proprietary). None installable here (no apt, release downloads 403).
keyFindings.implicationForOrbkin: Agent work happens in bpy/Python/Node; hand-painting and polishing passes are for the owner in Krita/Aseprite/Blockbench.

keyFindings.claim: Mixamo is free and royalty-free for games but raw files may not be redistributed, and it is humanoid-only.
keyFindings.detail: Adobe community FAQ mirror: commercial/non-commercial use OK, no distribution of raw character/animation files to non-team members, no ML training. Terms may change.
keyFindings.implicationForOrbkin: Fine for trainer/NPC animation baked into the build; avoid committing raw Mixamo FBX to the public repo; useless for non-humanoid creatures.

keyFindings.claim: Sketchfab and Poly Pizza are mostly CC-BY (attribution) and need owner downloads; Sketchfab downloads require login.
keyFindings.detail: Sketchfab: majority CC BY, some CC0, some NC (unusable commercially); Download API requires authenticated users. Poly Pizza: mostly CC-BY, some CC0; record title/creator/licence per model.
keyFindings.implicationForOrbkin: Use only with a credits screen and ASSETS.md provenance; prefer CC0 sources first.

keyFindings.claim: Free CC0 3D libraries are flat-colour low-poly, not HD-2D pixel art.
keyFindings.detail: KayKit uses gradient atlases, Quaternius/Kenney flat materials. Their value is geometry/silhouette and animation; the look comes from our texturing, lighting and low-res pipeline.
keyFindings.implicationForOrbkin: Plan a re-surfacing step (pixel textures, palette, texel density) for every imported asset rather than dropping them in.

keyFindings.claim: LPC pixel sprites are CC-BY-SA 3.0 / GPL 3 with per-artist credits.
keyFindings.detail: Universal LPC Spritesheet Generator requires crediting all contributors in-game; share-alike applies.
keyFindings.implicationForOrbkin: Avoid for hero art; share-alike and a recognisable style conflict with an original look.

techniques.name: Git sparse asset fetch with provenance
techniques.how: git clone --depth 1 --filter=blob:none --no-checkout <repo>; git show HEAD:<path> > out.glb; write {repo, sha, path, license} to a provenance JSON and ASSETS.md

techniques.name: Import-retexture-export with headless Blender
techniques.why: CC0 packs are flat low-poly; HD-2D needs our pixel surfaces
techniques.how: bpy: import_scene.gltf -> normalise scale -> replace materials with our palette/pixel textures (or remap KayKit gradient atlas) -> export_scene.gltf -> gltf-transform optimize

techniques.name: Use KayKit/Quaternius props as diorama clutter
techniques.why: Reference scenes read rich because of dense, well-modelled props
techniques.how: Pick shelves/barrels/crates/stairs/lanterns/trees; merge into arena batches to stay <100 draw calls
techniques.effort: 1 day per arena once the import script exists

techniques.name: Rigify or CC0 rigs for trainers
techniques.how: KayKit Adventurers rig+anims or Rigify-generated rigs, rendered through the existing sprite baker

techniques.name: HDRI-lit Cycles bakes
techniques.how: Load a drei-assets HDRI as world, bake AO/diffuse to textures by script

techniques.name: GLB optimisation for web
techniques.how: npx @gltf-transform/cli optimize in.glb out.glb --compress meshopt --texture-compress webp

techniques.name: Owner fetch list per milestone
techniques.why: Some best sources are blocked here
techniques.how: Write exact URLs + target paths; owner downloads and commits (Mixamo derived bakes, Poly Haven textures, itch packs)
